MUD - FIM Motocross World Championship.name: MUD: FIM Motocross World Championship
MUD - FIM Motocross World Championship.summary: The only videogame that exclusively features the MX1 and MX2 championships, comprehending all the teams and all the world-wide-known bikers and the amazing 2011 Monster Energy FIM Motocross of Nations. Pure and freestyle Motocross you have never seen before!

Monster High - New Ghoul in School.name: Monster High: New Ghoul in School
Monster High - New Ghoul in School.summary: Come roam the halls of Monster High and get to know your new classmates. Join clubs, make friends and dress up in fierce fashions. But be aware, there’s something strange going on at Monster High! Cleo’s new amulet has been cursed by the spirit of Spookenhamen, and the student body is falling under his spell. Show us how you boo to save the school and all your new classmates from the mummy’s curse!

Rock Band - Country Track Pack.name: Rock Band: Country Track Pack
Rock Band - Country Track Pack.summary: Rock Band Country Track Pack is a standalone game that wraps up 21 country songs into one retail package. The songs are a collection of previously released DLC, as well as new tracks that have yet to appear in any Rock Band game.

SBK Generations.name: SBK Generations
SBK Generations.summary:
The official game of the Superbike FIM World Championship is back this year on PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360 with the most comprehensive motorcycling simulation of all time.

Experience the last 4 seasons, including the new 2012 season, of the SBK world championship. Take the title of World Champion, take on the new SBK Experience mode and win the all-new single-maker races. With SBK Generations, Milestone is ready to release the definitive masterpiece of the motorcycling genre!

OFFICIAL MODE: experience the thrills of the official Superbike championship! Race as the SBK, SuperSport and SuperStock 1000 riders on the most famous circuits in the world, and relive the history-making races of the 2009 to 2012 seasons.
CARRIER MODE: take on the championships from 2009 to 2012 as your alter-ego, starting in the lower categories and going all the way to the premium class, where the World Champion title awaits.

SBK EXPERIENCE: a unique and innovative experience that brings you into the heart of the world of motorcycling through thrilling themed challenges and single-maker races, against the best riders in the world, including the Legends.

ONLINE: experience all the thrills of a real Superbike race, challenging up to 15 players online.

SingStar Chartbreaker.summary:
SingStar Chartbreaker is a game of the SingStar Series released in Germany.

Sonic Unleashed.name: Sonic Unleashed
Sonic Unleashed.summary: Gameplay in Sonic Unleashed focuses on two modes of platforming play: fast-paced levels that take place during daytime, showcasing Sonic's trademark speed as seen in previous games in the series, and slower, night-time levels, during which Sonic's Werehog form emerges, and gameplay switches to an action-based, brawler style of play, in which Sonic battles Gaia enemies
